dslRule:
<!id: split-null-initialized-local-variable>
<!description: Splits a local variable declaration that is initialized with a null literal into a declaration and an assignment. This transformation is applicable for Java 8 and later versions.>
<!severity: HINT>

$Type $var = $init; :: isNullLiteral($init) && isLocalVariable($var)
=>
$Type $var;
$var = $init;
;;
summary: Splits a local variable declaration that is initialized with a `null` literal into a separate declaration and assignment statement.
